scripts.Latin: ASCII, Latin-1, Latin Extended-A, the Vietnamese letters with stacked marks, and the ligatures and letters the names use
scripts.Greek: monotonic: the alphabet with tonos and dialytika

stems.h: the top half of a stem: it comes down to the x-height and squiggles back into the shoulder, so the left side never reaches the baseline
stems.b: a short stem from the ascender to half the x-height; the bubble floats above the baseline
stems.d: mirror of b: a short stem on the right, the bubble floats
stems.p: a stem from the x-height into the descender; the bowl sits on the baseline
stems.a: single-storey: a bowl and a right stroke from the x-height to the baseline
stems.f: a stem from the hook to the baseline, with a crossbar at the x-height
stems.g: single-storey: a bowl and a right stroke that descends and hooks left
stems.i: a short stem of x-height under its dot
stems.j: a stem from the x-height that descends and hooks left
stems.k: a full stem; both arms meet it at 42% of the x-height
stems.l: a full stem that curls right at the baseline
stems.t: a stem above and below the crossbar, curling right at the baseline
stems.y: the right arm continues below the baseline and hooks left
stems.lslash: a full stem that curls right at the baseline, with the bar across it
stems.hbar: the h with a bar across the top of its stem
stems.dcroat: the d with a bar across its stem
stems.tbar: the t with a second bar
stems.thorn: a stem from the ascender into the descender with a bowl at the x-height
stems.germandbls: a stem from the baseline to the ascender, with the top curling into the s
stems.eng: an n whose right leg descends and hooks left
